notes.env: robot.obstacle_sampling=linear interpolates only obstacle truth layer 5 for the v7 subcell distance field; policy input variant: no map-frame inputs, onboard odometry in state slots 0-6, true route only as priv_* decoder targets; training starts follow env.json task.* (10% at the race start, else uniform)
notes.model: size12m, batch 16 x 64, train ratio 32: the R8-P2 settings of the legacy checkpoint (nav4/policy.py make_config); the agent itself fixes these, the trainer asserts them
notes.model_overrides: The model note describes legacy defaults. Fresh runs take model, batch_size and batch_length from this config and store them in the portable checkpoint.
notes.xla_memory_fraction: null keeps the legacy guard-derived allocator limit. An explicit fraction sets the on-demand XLA cap independently of min_free_gpu_mib.
notes.replay: capacity 200000 steps (R8-P2 value); 65-step sequences = batch_length + replay_context; LZ4-compressed in RAM, chunks of 64, upstream online queue
notes.warmup_steps: batched env steps before the replay reports its items (r8 pattern): every slot then holds a full 65-step sequence and the official Ratio starts without a backlog
notes.save_minutes: official checkpoint (agent, replay, driver and runtime state) and latest.pkl every 10 min of wall time
notes.min_free_gpu_mib: start only if nvidia-smi free + this process's use >= this; checked again before every checkpoint; also the XLA allocator cap (XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION = this / total)
notes.eval: every 30 min of training time, separate 4-slot env: full traverses from task.route_start, deterministic actions, assists after failures; seed 914901 = the nav4_dev evaluation seed (paired at reset with nav4.evaluate --repeats 4 --seed 914901 --assist)
notes.eval.max_steps: 15000 steps = 3000 s simulated per traverse, i.e. 728 m at >= 0.25 m/s including assists; slower traverses are reported truncated with their final station
